title: FormSchemaResponse
description: Response body of GET /api/panels/:id/form-schema (HEL-1784): the declarations of ONLY the fields the form binds (its configured `sourceField`s), in the dataset's declared order, for the dashboard's owner or an editor. Nothing else of the dataset's schema is returned, and no row. Each item is the declaration `GET /api/data-sources/:id/schema` emits.
